notes.title: Merry Christmas 2020!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

Magic Chess Online wishes you all a very Merry Christmas! Take care of yourself and your loved ones!

We take advantage of this message to announce that we have added a new chessboard to celebrate this event, but not only!

[h1]Christmas 2020[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38455630/22aa725db9666132051f9376c51669a7ff0f7de5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Abandoned House[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38455630/668d4689050f7b7e2d6704c171429a48d5223232.jpg[/img]

[h1]Victorian Manor[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38455630/c6a861eeeddcd204016dac629e722f664d658dd3.jpg[/img]

We will get back to you very, very soon to officially announce the start of the Closed Beta!

Happy Holidays to all and see you soon in Magic Chess Online!
